import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Codeforces {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String line = reader.readLine();
        reader.close();

        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(line);
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        double p = Double.parseDouble(st.nextToken());

        int answer = n;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (computeChance(n, i) >= p) {
                answer = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
    }

    static long choose(int total, int pick) {
        if (pick < 0 || pick > total) return 0;
        if (pick == 0 || pick == total) return 1;
        pick = Math.min(pick, total - pick);
        long result = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= pick; j++) {
            result = result * (total - pick + j) / j;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static double computeChance(int n, int x) {
        if (x < 3) return 0.0;
        
        long numerator = choose(x, 3); // Both players pick from studied maps, system picks from remaining 2 studied
        numerator += choose(x, 2) * choose(n - x, 1) * 2; // One player picks studied, one picks unstudied, system picks from remaining 1 studied
        numerator += choose(x, 1) * choose(n - x, 2); // Both players pick unstudied, system picks from remaining 1 studied
        
        long denominator = choose(n, 3);
        return (double) numerator / denominator;
    }
}
